// A small deck with every kind of source ADR-0018 counts: Sol Ring, Mind Stone,
// a Talisman, a dork, and Rashmi in the command zone asking for a red that only
// the Talisman makes. Small enough that both engines answer it: the exact one
// by enumerating, the sampler by dealing.
1x Rashmi and Ragavan [Commander{top}]
1x Sol Ring [Ramp]
1x Mind Stone [Ramp]
1x Talisman of Creativity [Ramp]
1x Elvish Mystic [Ramp]
2x Memory Lapse [Counter]
6x Island [Land]
5x Forest [Land]
12x Opt [Filler]
